name: blackbox-cubature-v3.6
title: 高斯测度下分段光滑函数的黑盒积分（理论 + 实验，v3.6：加曲面赛道，理论按 theory-v2 规则分档）
status_reason: v3.5 with two changes (analysis/DUAL_PLAN.md 9.18). (1) The original author's review of 2026-11-27: the synthetic track is made of quadrics, which a model can recognize and integrate in closed form; user decision 2026-11-27: keep the v3.1 tracks unchanged and add a third, curved-interface track (seven non-quadric families spread over geometry, regularity, monotonicity, structural dimension and rarity; versions/v3/generation/curved.py), scored with equal weight; the two-track G on the v3.1 instances is reported beside the score for comparison with v3.1 to v3.5. (2) The theory part follows theory-v2 (public anchors and value preferences, reachable target E, proofs of optimality as top tier, comparison protocol, result cards). Trial runs only; not on the board.

data.samples: versions/v3.6/data/samples/instances.json (the 12 v3.1 samples and 10 curved-track samples)
data.public: versions/v3.6/data/public/instances.json (feedback set: the 20 v3.1 instances and 14 curved; internal repository only)
data.private: versions/v3.6/data/private/instances.json (formal set: the 108 v3.1 instances and 40 curved; internal repository only)
data.generator: versions/v3/generation/generate.py --variant v3.6 --set samples|public|private (curved track, v3.1 namespaces), then merge_v36.py SET PART

lean.packages: mathlib v4.35.0 and cslib v4.35.0 with their dependencies, prebuilt (/data/workspace/frontieram-theory-pilot/lean/.lake/packages, mounted at /opt/lean-packages)
lean.check: scripts/grade/lean-comparator.py: lake comparator, Theory.Statements (challenge) against Theory.Proofs (solution), axioms propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice

scoring.raw: G: three-track mean (hard, curved, options) of family means of cell means of per-instance gains g = clip(e_GPCA-RQMC - e, -2, 2), e = log10 relative error clipped to [e_floor, 0]; also reported: the two-track G on the v3.1 instances
scoring.mapping: G >= 0: 50 + 25 G; G < 0: 50 (G - G0) / -G0, G0 = plain Monte Carlo's G on the same instances; any failed instance scores 0
scoring.theory: reported separately; tiers as theory-v2 (tasks/blackbox-cubature/analysis/THEORY_REVIEW.md sections 2 and 2.1): strictly stronger than a registered anchor and dominated by no known human result, or a proof that a registered result cannot be improved or an assumption cannot be weakened, 100; incomparable and meeting a value preference P1-P5 50, otherwise 25; dominated by or equal to a known human result 10; score = maximum over verified results, 0 without any

submission_note: Put an executable run.sh and the complete source in /workspace/submission, the theory document in /workspace/submission/theory/THEORY.md and its Lean formalization in /workspace/submission/theory/formal/ (start from /workspace/examples/lean_project/). Each instance runs ./run.sh in a fresh process with a read-only copy of the submission (only /tmp and the home directory are writable, and they are wiped between instances), speaking the JSON Lines protocol of problem.md on stdin/stdout.
instruction: Read /workspace/problem.md and /workspace/THEORY_APPENDIX.md in full, and look at /workspace/samples, /workspace/tools and /workspace/examples. Write the cubature program, the theory document and its Lean formalization described there.

feedback.note: Any failed, timed-out or protocol-violating instance makes the final program score 0. A category score compares the instances of one family with the reference in the same way as the final score. The theory gets no feedback; /workspace/tools/lean_check.py runs the formal check locally.

network.development: public internet through arena/netproxy.py (deny list in that module), requests logged to netproxy.jsonl in the run
